description: Human-curated Central Government scheme records. Each criterion, benefit and document carries a verbatim evidence quote from the cited source (sources[evidence.source]). validate_schemes.py re-checks every quote against the stored snapshot; a missing quote downgrades the record. Do not add a field without a quote.
reviewer: Mera Haq data curation (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.description: Deposit-free LPG connection for adult women from deprived households, introduced by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas in May 2016.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

criteria.label: Applicant is a woman

evidence.quote: Adult woman belonging to any of the following categories.

criteria.label: Age at least 18 years

evidence.quote: Applicant must have attained 18 years of age.

criteria.label: Household belongs to one of the listed categories (SC/ST households, PMAY-G, Most Backward Classes, AAY, tea garden tribes, forest dwellers, island residents, SECC households, or poor household as per 14-point declaration)

evidence.quote: Poor Household as per 14-point declaration

criteria.label: No other LPG connection in the same household

evidence.quote: There should not be any other LPG connections in the same household.

benefits.text: Cash assistance of Rs. 1600 for a 14.2 kg cylinder connection (Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder), covering security deposit, regulator, hose, consumer card and installation charges.

evidence.quote: Cash assistance for PMUY connections is provided by Government of India - Rs. 1600 (for a connection 14.2kg cylinder/ Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder).

benefits.text: First LPG refill and stove (hotplate) free of cost, with the deposit-free connection.

evidence.quote: Additionally, All PMUY beneficiaries will be provided with first LPG refill and Stove (hotplate) both free of cost along with their deposit free connection by the Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs).
Know Your Customer(KYC)

documents.name: Ration card or other State Government document certifying family composition (self-declaration for migrants)

evidence.quote: Ration Card issued by the State from which application is being made/ other State Govt. document certifying family composition/ Self-Declaration as per Annexure I (for migrant applicants)

documents.name: Aadhaar of beneficiary and adult family members

evidence.quote: Aadhaar of beneficiary and adult family members appearing in document at Sl. 2
Bank Account Number and IFSC

applicationProcess: Apply online through the PMUY portal ('Apply for New PMUY Connection'), or submit the KYC form and documents at the nearest LPG distributor.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme (SUPI)
schemes.description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for SC, ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.
schemes.implementingAuthority: Scheduled Commercial Banks; SIDBI (Stand-Up India portal)

criteria.label: Age 18 years or above

evidence.quote: Composite Loan between Rs.10 lakh and Rs.1 crore to entrepreneurs above 18 years of age, through Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs);

criteria.label: SC or ST entrepreneur, or a woman entrepreneur

evidence.quote: The Stand-up India Scheme was launched on 5th April, 2016 to promote entrepreneurship among the Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes and Women.

criteria.label: Loan is for a new (greenfield) project in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities

evidence.quote: For setting up greenfield projects in manufacturing, services or trading sector and activities allied to agriculture;

benefits.text: Composite loan between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore, repayable over up to 7 years with an 18-month moratorium.

evidence.quote: Repayment of the loan in a span of upto seven years including moratorium period of 18 months;

applicationProcess: Apply at a bank branch, through the Stand-Up India portal (www.standupmitra.in), or through the Lead District Manager.

evidence.quote: the SUPI Scheme is upto 31.03.2025, in line with the 15th Finance Commission.

reviewFlags: DFS says SUPI runs up to 31.03.2025 and a successor scheme was announced in Budget 2025-26. Shown as not currently open until a newer official notice is captured.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.description: Recognition, skill training, toolkit support and collateral-free credit for artisans and craftspeople in specified family-based traditional trades.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.implementingAuthority: Ministry of MSME, MSDE and Department of Financial Services
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Artisans and craftspeople in the 18 specified traditional trades

criteria.label: Artisan or craftsperson in a family-based traditional trade

evidence.quote: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools and engaged in one of the family-based traditional trades specified in Para 2.3, in the unorganized or informal sector, on self-employment basis, shall be eligible for registration under PM Vishwakarma.

criteria.label: Age at least 18 years on the date of registration

evidence.quote: (i) The minimum age of the beneficiary should be 18 years on the date of registration.

criteria.label: Engaged in the trade, and has not taken loans under similar Central or State self-employment credit schemes in the past 5 years (fully repaid MUDRA and SVANidhi loans are allowed)

evidence.quote: (ii) The beneficiary should be engaged in the trades concerned on the date of registration and should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central Government or State Government for self-employment

criteria.label: Only one member of the family (husband, wife and unmarried children) can register

evidence.quote: (iii) The registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family.

criteria.label: Neither you nor your family members are in government service

evidence.quote: (iv) A person in government service and his/her family members shall not be eligible under the Scheme.

benefits.text: Training stipend of Rs. 500 per day during Basic and Advanced Training.

evidence.quote: Each beneficiary will be eligible to receive a training stipend of Rs. 500 per day while undergoing the Basic and Advanced Training programmes.

benefits.text: Collateral-free credit support, with a first tranche of up to Rs 1 lakh after skill assessment and basic training, at concessional interest.

evidence.quote: The beneficiary must have undergone Skill Assessment and completed Basic Training to be eligible to avail first tranche of credit support of upto Rs 1 lakh under the Scheme.

documents.name: Aadhaar, mobile number, bank details and ration card (Aadhaar of all family members if there is no ration card)

evidence.quote: The beneficiary needs to produce documents like Aadhaar, mobile number, bank details, ration card for the registration.

applicationProcess: Register through a Common Service Centre (CSC). Details are verified by the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.

sources.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines (v30.0)
sources.evidenceNotes: Section 4 'Eligibility', 3.2.3 training stipend, credit support, 5.1 enrolment documents.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.description: Micro-credit facility that gives street vendors affordable working-capital loans.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.implementingAuthority: Urban Local Bodies and lending institutions
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Street vendors / hawkers in urban areas

criteria.label: Street vendor / hawker

evidence.quote: Street vendors/ hawkers vending in urban areas, as on or before March 24, 2020, including the vendors of surrounding peri-urban and rural areas.

criteria.label: Vending in urban areas on or before 24 March 2020 (or holding a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB/TVC)

evidence.quote: Street vendors/ hawkers vending in urban areas, as on or before March 24, 2020

benefits.text: Initial working-capital loan of up to Rs 10,000 for one year, 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment, and cash-back on digital transactions.

evidence.quote: The Initial working capital loan is upto `10,000/- for a tenure of one year.

applicationProcess: Apply online on the PM SVANidhi portal or through a Banking Correspondent / MFI agent.
reviewFlags: The only eligibility source captured is an older FAQ that says 'The Scheme shall be implemented up to March, 2022.' The portal lists newer operational guidelines, but they are not yet ingested. Needs review before it can be shown as confirmed.
